verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents some batch-style operations: scheduled Blob Storage Export for large volumes, experiments run across whole datasets, and LLM-as-a-judge evaluators applied to samples of live traffic. These are bulk processing, not general bulk actions on selected items. One hands-on user reported the trace retrieval API was 'brutally slow for bulk scanning' and bypassed it by querying the database directly. missing for 10: documented bulk actions on selected items (bulk delete, tag, score, add-to-dataset or add-to-queue), a bulk-mutation API or CLI, and evidence that bulk reads via the API perform well at scale.
